text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year. I'm counting on your
support
this year as well.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, indeed.

We decide to watch footage of past
races to
prepare for this year's Classic
Triple Crown.

On the screen, we see Tokai Teio—a
peppy,
self-confident Umamusume who
idolizes Symboli
Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
No one can catch her! She's the
undefeated Twin
Crown Champion,
Tokai Teio!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Her body is agile, and she has an
indomitable will. She had a great
showing at the Satsuki Sho and
the
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone expects her to go undefeated
and win
the Triple Crown!

Tokai Teio is on screen again,
triumphantly
raising her hand in a peace
sign.

Her graceful run across the turf had all
the
spectators captivated.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
So it's powerful racers like her who
run in
the
Classic Triple Crown races.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Negative. Why would I be feeling any
pressure
now?
choice_data_list: Did that end up putting pressure o...
Did that put too much pressure on you?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed she is, but that information is
irrelevant to
me.

With that odd statement, Mihono
Bourbon turns
back to the screen.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Processing venue atmosphere, racer
speeds, and
match progression...
Complete.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
With this knowledge regarding the
Classic Triple
Crown, I can begin doing
mental simulations.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
We will reach our objective through
daily training
and further stamina
enhancement.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. One problem exists, however.
choice_data_list: Let's do our best to reach our goal!

text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon's expression turns
slightly sullen.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I don't fully understand your other order.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To be a runner who "inspires courage in
others."

Come to think of it,
I do recall giving her
that
"order" before.

The way you run inspires courage in
others... I'm
so proud of you.

The way you run inspires courage in
others... I'm
so proud of you.

...Continue to prove that hard work
surpasses
talent.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I have updated my objectives.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
They now include the Twinkle Series, the
Classic
Triple Crown, and showing the
value of hard
work.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Although I acknowledged your order,
this
concept of "courage" has not yet
been entered
into my database.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Incidentally, I also have no experience
with
"inspiring others" or "being inspired"
myself.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Executing your order will prove difficult
for as long as I don't have sufficient
understanding of
these sensations and
experiences.

Although her face is expressionless, she
still
seems somewhat downhearted.

I think for a moment about how I can
cheer her
up.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order acknowledged. Searching for an
area where
mochi can be produced.
choice_data_list: Let's come up with a new technique.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
There is a New Year's mochi-pounding

tournament in the shopping district
today. We
can go there.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Ha! Yah! Ha! Yah!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Staff
text_block_list.text: Whoa! You're pretty good at this!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I am confident in my physical

strength.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Would you care to try, Trainer? It's just
the right
amount of exercise that makes
one feel refreshed.

The words of praise raise Mihono
Bourbon's
spirits as she continues to
aggressively pound the
mochi.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order acknowledged. Switching to
terrestrial
television.
Bip! Bzzzzt...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
An error has occurred. The television has
turned
off.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Proposing a makeshift solution. Should I
smack
the television?
Luckily, the TV starts working again.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what was the meaning of that
last joke?

Mihono Bourbon watches the witty
one-liners with
intense concentration.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order acknowledged. I shall devise a
new running
technique.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Since testing is essential for the
technique to
work, let us move to the
track.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
As an extra, I can also devise a name for
the
technique.

We head for the track, where we work
on
concocting and mastering a new
technique until
sundown.

It seems like today's activities have
helped clear Mihono Bourbon's mind. I'm
sure she'll come to
understand the
meaning of courage soon enough.

After all, we're going to spend this year
storming
through the Classics together!
